name: Dunemaul Compound
summary: Dunemaul Compound serves as the central settlement and ogre mound for the Dunemaul clan in Tanaris. Tucked into the rocky ridges bordering the desert wastes, it houses the clan's brute enforcers and spellcasters.

sections.title: A Stronghold in the Sands
sections.body: Carved into the rugged desert rock of western Tanaris, the Dunemaul Compound is the primary stronghold of the Dunemaul ogres. These hulking desert dwellers have adapted to the harsh arid climate, scratching out an existence through brute force and opportunism. The compound itself centers on an ogre mound and cave network. Though primitive, the clan fields a dangerous mix of warriors, enforcers, and twisted spellcasters practicing dark warlock and mage magics. For travelers journeying across the dunes, the settlement is a treacherous den of aggressive giants who violently reject uninvited guests.

faq.answer: The compound belongs to the Dunemaul clan, a reclusive band of desert ogres who answer to no outside power. Their leaders hold the central cave at the heart of the settlement, directing the clan's defenses across the sands.

faq.q: What kinds of ogres live here?
faq.answer: The settlement contains a wide variety of Dunemaul ogres, ranging from common brutes and enforcers to cunning ogre mages and warlocks wielding dark fel and shadow magic.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in this compound?
faq.answer: In the present era the Horde has no real stake in the compound. Unlike most ogres, the Dunemaul keep to themselves around their precious desert water, answer to no outside power, and treat any visitor as an intruder.
Omgorn the Lost is an elusive, solitary ogre known to occasionally wander the edges of the Dunemaul Compound, distinct from the common sentries patrolling the mound.

angles.text: Though many ogres once marched with the Old Horde, the reclusive Dunemaul answer to no outside power and treat Horde travelers as intruders like any other.
The presence of Dunemaul warlocks among a seemingly primitive desert clan is a curious sight, showing that shadow and fel traditions have taken root even within isolated ogre mounds.
